source_level_question: Can one single broad height-varying non-bar lobe in CelineRoomWindowFoldDetailV80, while keeping the currently proven low-contrast fold material, plausibly clear a material row-axis improvement gate in both clean sheers?

proven_live_fold_material_response.only_change: move the existing two sheer fold facets onto the accepted panel centers
proven_live_fold_material_response.finding: This is a strong direct proof of the present fold material/coverage response. The response is spatially constant where the full-height planar facet covers the panel.

reference_linked_row_axis_gate.rule: Use the same 20% material-error reduction discipline that prevented flat micro-tuning elsewhere: each clean sheer must reduce its absolute error to the reference-linked row-mean-luminance standard deviation by at least 20%, with manual visual agreement.

coverage_only_upper_bound.derivation: For one constant-color overlay/lobe using the proven current fold material, a row's added mean luminance is bounded between 0 and the observed full-coverage luminance delta 4.7456. By Popoviciu's inequality, the standard deviation of that bounded added row signal cannot exceed half its range: 2.3728. By the triangle inequality for standard deviation, candidate row std is therefore no greater than current row std + 2.3728, even under an unrealistically optimal coverage waveform.
coverage_only_upper_bound.conclusion: A single broad height-varying lobe that keeps the presently proven low-contrast constant fold material cannot clear the 20% reference-linked row-axis error gate in BOTH sheers, regardless of taper shape or projected coverage. The right sheer fails even the generous mathematical upper bound.

normal_only_cross_check.evidence: Real Candidate #1346 replaced each broad sheer with a smooth low-amplitude pleated surface/tangent field while preserving accepted color/envelope.
normal_only_cross_check.observed_response: sub-1% clean-ROI changed pixels with max one-code-value channel delta and no material visual improvement
normal_only_cross_check.conclusion: There is no evidence that merely twisting/tapering normals under the current room lighting can supply the missing factor. Normal-only geometry is therefore not an independent rescue for the same-material single-lobe bound.

causal_conclusion.reason: Direct raster response plus a conservative mathematical upper bound show the right sheer cannot reach the minimum reference-linked row-axis improvement using only current fold-material coverage, while the already-tested smooth normal/pleat path is flat. Another build on width/taper/twist alone would be speculative and violates the efficiency/stop-loss policy.
causal_conclusion.what_would_be_independent: A provably live room-local mechanism that creates continuous within-lobe intensity variation larger than the current constant fold-material delta without returning to baseColorMap modulation or many dark bars—for example a verified per-vertex color/gradient path, a separate bounded material parameter that interpolates spatially, or another independently evidenced material owner.
